perks.name: Attrition Orbs

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.desc: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Demolitionist

perks.name: Delicate Tuning

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Cooling Baubles

Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle reduces heat.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.desc: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.desc: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Master of Arms
perks.desc: Kills with any weapon improve this weapon's damage for a short time.

perks.name: Thermal Atomization
perks.desc: While at high heat, this weapon deals increased damage and causes targets to explode when defeated.

perks.name: Air-Cooled Core
perks.desc: Sprinting increases vent or reload speed for a short time. While at low heat or full magazine, gain increased handling and movement speed when aiming down sights.

perks.name: Accelerated Assault
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon loads a small amount of ammo from reserves, or removes heat, and slightly increases damage.

notes: Inspired by https://www.youtube.com/@Legoleflash (PvP PvP-Duel PvP-God M+KB Controller): God-roll PvP for duelling. The M-17 "Fast Talker" is, at time of writing, an S-Tier primary, which Lego describes as "an ultra-accurate bullet hose in PvP", demonstrated in his video (https://youtu.be/LldDti54Gwo?si=9j382iCFlMJE7tuF). The heat frame is like an extra perk set, first providing reduced heat generation, significantly increasing the number of shots before overheating, and providing a pseudo-Reconstruction, automatically "refilling" as the weapon loses heat when not being used. Balanced Heat weapons have a ×2 vent rate if you manually reload when the heat bar is at >87.5% of maximum heat to proc Perfect Vent, as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. Additionally, this offers the +20 Mobility stat boost and ×1.0625 base movement speed of a Lightweight frame. The @hugowo_ spreadsheet at https://www.destiny2.science/, shows a base TTK of 0.733s (11c1b) - this is made easier (10c2b) at 175 weapons state, and a faster 0.667s TTK (11c0b) at 186 weapons. The 80% crit accuracy-adjusted TTK is 0.800s (10c3b), made easier (9c4b) at 164 weapons. The stats package is one of the best looking for lightweight SMGs, and you can get enhanced barrel, mag, weapon mods and origin traits to improve further at Tiers 4 and 5. You can see the in-game effect of stat changes at https://d2foundry.gg/w/1419158093 for yourself. For this duelling god roll, look for all range with barrel and mag perks. Then to boost range further, in the first trait perk column there's Delicate Tuning, which works like a Heat weapon's mirror to Closing Time, boosting Range by +20 (+22 when enhanced), Handling and Accuracy when a weapon's cold, with the benefits reducing to half at 50% heat - so your first shots will be at or near 100 range. As a pairing in the second column we can use Tap the Trigger, which for 0.6s (0.76s when enhanced) after a trigger pull provides +40 Stability, ×0.5 recoil and ×0.9 Accuracy Cone size. With a high enough weapons stat, this buff should last as long as your TTK, combining 100 Range, 89 Stability, halved recoil and the Lightweight frame boosts. You can see the gunplay for this in Lego's video. The Fleet Footed origin trait is useful for PvP, stacking up to ×1 on hits and ×2 on kills to boost movement speed and Airborne Effectiveness for a refreshable 5s (6s enhanced). Accelerated Assault sounds good, providing 10% cooling and ×1.05 damage when you hit 3 times with 0.8-1.2s between each hit, but it takes at least 1.6s to proc, so you're not likely to see any benefit within a normal TTK window. Recommended MW: Range, with a Range mod.

Once the second stack timer runs out, you'll drop back down to the timer for one stack to repeat the process. If you can put in the work, it's possible to achieve a 0.400s (7c0b) using Mask of Bakris Light Shift ×3 on top. You can see the gunplay for this in Lego's video. The Fleet Footed origin trait is useful for PvP, stacking up to ×1 on hits and ×2 on kills to boost movement speed and Airborne Effectiveness for a refreshable 5s (6s enhanced). Inspired by https://www.youtube.com/@Legoleflash (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): PvE god-roll for both super generation in boss DPS phases and single-target damage against tougher enemies in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. The M-17 "Fast Talker" is a Balanced Heat SMG which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic, and which Lego describes as "a machine gun disguised as an SMG", demonstrated in his video (https://youtu.be/LldDti54Gwo?si=9j382iCFlMJE7tuF). The heat frame is like an extra perk set, first providing reduced heat generation, significantly increasing the number of shots before overheating, and providing a pseudo-Reconstruction, automatically "refilling" as the weapon loses heat when not being used. Balanced Heat weapons have a ×2 vent rate if you manually reload when the heat bar is at >87.5% of maximum heat to proc Perfect Vent, as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. Additionally, this offers the +20 Mobility stat boost and ×1.0625 base movement speed of a Lightweight frame. The stats package is one of the best looking for lightweight SMGs, and you can get enhanced barrel, mag, weapon mods and origin traits to improve further at Tiers 4 and 5. You can see the in-game effect of stat changes at https://d2foundry.gg/w/1419158093 for yourself. Look for some extra range with the barrel perk, without any penalties. Then, to maximise firing time, look for a heatsink perk that reduces heat generation. In the first trait perk column, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after 20-22 hits, depending on the heatsink perk, within 5s of each other to proc armour mods, while in the second Target Lock stacks up to 5 times on repeated hits within 0.2s of each other for up to ×1.4 damage at 110.33% of base magazine capacity - so should proc if you can time your manual vent correctly. This, particularly with Titan Peacekeepers, should be a good primary to use in longer boss DPS phases to generate super energy, especially if you get the rare Accelerated Assault origin trait. For the Origin Trait Air-Cooled Core improves handling and ADS speed when heat is <10%, and boosts Vent Speed for 6s after sprinting. You can see the gunplay for this in Lego's video. The Fleet Footed origin trait is probably more useful for PvP, stacking up to ×1 on hits and ×2 on kills to boost movement speed and Airborne Effectiveness for a refreshable 5s (6s enhanced). If you're lucky, you'll drop one with the rare Accelerated Assault origin trait which provides 10% cooling and ×1.05 damage when you hit 3 times with 0.8-1.2s between each hit. Recommended MW: Cooling Efficiency or Reload (Vent) Speed, with a Heat Generated mod, or your choice depending on your play style.

This, particularly with Titan Peacekeepers, should be a good primary to use in longer boss DPS phases to generate super energy, especially if you get the rare Accelerated Assault origin trait. Inspired by https://www.youtube.com/@Legoleflash (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): PvE god-roll for controlling Minor adds in general at-level or better content, particularly for Stasis builds. The M-17 "Fast Talker" is a Balanced Heat SMG which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic, and which Lego describes as "a machine gun disguised as an SMG", demonstrated in his video (https://youtu.be/LldDti54Gwo?si=9j382iCFlMJE7tuF). The heat frame is like an extra perk set, first providing reduced heat generation, significantly increasing the number of shots before overheating, and providing a pseudo-Reconstruction, automatically "refilling" as the weapon loses heat when not being used. Balanced Heat weapons have a ×2 vent rate if you manually reload when the heat bar is at >87.5% of maximum heat to proc Perfect Vent, as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. Additionally, this offers the +20 Mobility stat boost and ×1.0625 base movement speed of a Lightweight frame. The stats package is one of the best looking for lightweight SMGs, and you can get enhanced barrel, mag, weapon mods and origin traits to improve further at Tiers 4 and 5. You can see the in-game effect of stat changes at https://d2foundry.gg/w/2770035786 for yourself. Look for some extra range with the barrel perk, without any penalties. For a Minor add clearing roll, in the first trait perk column Demolitionist generates chunk grenade ability energy on kills and an instant magazine refill on grenade use. This pairs well with Crystalline Corpsebloom, which procs on a kill to provide a 4s buff - kills with the buff active generate a Stasis seeker which travels 3m before spawning a medium Stasis crystal (large when enhanced) - these are weapon-generated entities so can proc weapon traits like Demolitionist when shattered for AoE damage. You can see the gunplay for this in Lego's video. The Fleet Footed origin trait is probably more useful for PvP, stacking up to ×1 on hits and ×2 on kills to boost movement speed and Airborne Effectiveness for a refreshable 5s (6s enhanced). If you're lucky, you'll drop one with the rare Accelerated Assault origin trait which provides 10% cooling and ×1.05 damage when you hit 3 times with 0.8-1.2s between each hit. Recommended MW: Cooling Efficiency or Reload (Vent) Speed, with a Heat Generated mod, or your choice depending on your play style.

Inspired by https://www.youtube.com/@cammycakesgaming (PvP PvP-Duel PvP-God M+KB Controller): God-roll PvP for 6s, particularly with Stasis builds. M-17 "Fast Talker" is, at time of writing, an S-Tier primary option for CQC. It's a Heat weapon - which means you get an ersatz Reconstruction for free from the passive cooling - with a rapid-fire fire rate. The Balanced Heat frame provides a ×2 vent rate if you manually vent when weapon heat is >87.5%. The @hugowo_ spreadsheet at https://www.destiny2.science/, shows the optimum TTK at base as 0.667s (10c1b) - increasing the weapons stat to 174 makes the TTK easier (9c2b), and at 186 the TTK is 0.600s (10c0b) - if you can hit your crits with an SMG! The 80% crit accuracy-adjusted TTK is 0.733s (9c3b), which at 162 weapons is easier (8c4b). The stats are good compared to other lightweight SMGs and make this one of the best SMGs in the game. You can see the in-game effect of stat changes at https://d2foundry.gg/w/2770035786 for yourself, once the formulas have been worked out. For the barrel perk, Extended Barrel or Chambered Compensator take Recoil Direction to 95 - if you're using Shrewd Survivor armour for the two-piece Reflex Action set bonus this boosts Handling and Accuracy. For the battery perk, the best option is Projection Fuse to increase Range. For a duelling roll, Delicate Tuning in the first trait perk column works like a Heat weapon's mirror to Closing Time, boosting Range, Handling and Accuracy when a weapon's cold with the benefits reducing to half at 50% heat. Put that with Tap the Trigger in the second column, and this almost feels like an aimbot. Bakris Hunters can make this really potent at 3 stacks of Light Shift, or Strand Titans can generate a Diamond Lance after 3 kills. Otherwise, Target Lock can also work on non-stasis builds to make the TTK a little more forgiving. The Imperial Allegiance origin trait is situationally useful if you're near one, two or three teammates when heat is >50%, boosting both cooling efficiency and damage by up to ×1.105, but Accelerated Assault is probably better, proccing 10% cooling and ×1.05 damage when you hit 3 times with 1.2-4s between each hit. Recommended MW: Range, Handling or Cooling Efficiency, with a Heat Generated mod/enhanced mod, or your choice depending on your play style.

SpaceMonkey (PvE / God-PvE): "This is a really hard weapon to evaluate for both PvE and PvP as it is our only Balanced Heat weapon (at least until the dungeon comes out). Remember that Balanced weapons need to be manually reloaded/vented just before overheating to get the massive reload bonus. If you're good at that little minigame then this is the best Peacekeepers DPS roll in the kinetic slot (you really want Accelerated Assault for that purpose). This is probably just fine in roam content so if you enjoy it go ahead. For PvP this could be quite good or excessively mediocre. It has the rolls for it, just a question of how the frame performs. After doing some testing basically any target lock fast talker with accelerated assault is slightly superior to antedate for peacekeepers dps. With that in mind if you go attrition orbs then you'll be consistently getting some good utility while doing a solid rotation. That being said cooling baubles has the potential to go absolutely nuts if you can pick up some orbs or elemental pickups while strafing and shooting: we're talking like 2-5x longer single mag than either antedate or a non-baubles fast talker. So the way to look at it is that cooling baubles won't always work, but the gun at base will still be slightly better than an antedate and it has the potential to every once in awhile go nuts on dps. Conversely attrition orbs has a lower ceiling but will more consistently pump out utility. Both good options, just depends on your roll and your personal preference." Recommended MW: Reload, Cooling Efficiency.
